evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-719 CONVERSION-CEILING DISSOCIATION DIAGNOSTIC (MECH-309 / ARC-062; experiment_purpose=diagnostic, EXCLUDED from governance scoring). Dissociates two agent states the campaign DV committed_class_entropy CONFLATES: (A) genuine monomodal policy collapse (same first-action regardless of state -- the real MECH-309 pathology) vs (B) decisive state-appropriate commitment (different actions in different states -- a WORKING agent a marginal-entropy metric wrongly flags as collapsed). Marginal entropy cannot separate them; I(state;committed) can. Single all-ON config (V3-EXQ-714 ARM_ON stack: SP-CEM + e2_world_forward SD-056 + MECH-448 demotion + MECH-449 Go/No-Go + P3 OFC valuation + lateral_pfc CRF bias, use_candidate_rule_field=True) over seeds [42, 43, 44]; P0 e2 warmup -> P1 two-head REINFORCE -> P2 long eval/logging. Per P2 tick logs a GROUND-TRUTH state_bin (nearest-salient-entity-type x relative-direction, read off env.grid/agent_x/agent_y -- NOT fed to the agent), the executed committed first-action class, and behavioural competence (resources/hazards/contamination per episode, mean reward). THREE DV families: (1) marginal committed-class entropy (reproduces the ceiling); (2) I(state;committed) + H(committed|state) + normalized_mi, DEBIASED with a 200-permutation shuffle null (mi_debiased = raw - null_mean; real coupling = raw > null_p95); (3) competence. Pre-registered dissociation (self-routed label is a HYPOTHESIS, NOT a verdict): mi_debiased > 0.05 nats AND raw>p95 on >= 2/3 AND competence supra-random -> decisive_state_appropriate_commitment (ceiling is largely a metric artifact; reframes MECH-309/ARC-062); mi_debiased ~0 AND not real-coupled -> genuine_monomodal_collapse (warrants GAP-A-divergence-survival substrate build); under-sampled/mixed -> substrate_not_ready_requeue. interpretation_label=substrate_not_ready_requeue. readiness_met=False. PROMOTES / DEMOTES NOTHING by itself; route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication.

interpretation_grid.decisive_state_appropriate_commitment: mi_debiased HIGH (state genuinely drives commitment; > floor on a majority of seeds AND raw_mi above the shuffle p95 on >= MI_REAL_MIN_SEEDS) AND competence supra-random. The agent commits to DIFFERENT, state-appropriate first-actions in DIFFERENT states -- the low MARGINAL committed_class entropy the campaign reads as a 'ceiling' is LARGELY a marginal-entropy ARTIFACT of a working state-conditioned policy. HYPOTHESIS (not a verdict): reframes MECH-309 / ARC-062 -- route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication before any governance action.
interpretation_grid.genuine_monomodal_collapse: mi_debiased ~0 (<= floor) AND raw_mi NOT above the shuffle p95 -- the committed first-action is statistically independent of world-state. The low marginal entropy is a TRUE collapse signature: the agent does the same thing regardless of state. HYPOTHESIS (not a verdict): supports MECH-309 as a real pathology and warrants the GAP-A-divergence-survival substrate build -- route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication.
interpretation_grid.substrate_not_ready_requeue: MI under-sampled (too few total P2 ticks OR too few occupied state-bins on a majority of seeds), OR the gates were mixed (neither branch cleanly met). NOT a dissociation verdict -- re-queue at a larger P2 budget / more seeds. Do NOT draw a conclusion about MECH-309 / ARC-062.
